description:
### Release v3.16.6

- **Manual Custom Package Name & App Name in Package Rename**: Upgraded the `Package Rename` patch options to allow completely free-form manual editing for both package name (`custom_package_name`, default: `dev.jason.com.google.android.inputmethod.latin`) and application display name (`app_display_name`).
- **Multi-Version Coexistence**: Enables installing and running official Gboard, 18.0.3 Patches, and 18.5.4 Beta Patches simultaneously on the same device without conflicts or crashes.
